'''Bimbam Toop''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Toop worked as the [[Foreman/Legends|foreman]] of a Gungan work crew and in about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he and his crew visited the bar [[Frundle's Cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Keren/Legends|Keren]]. However, after drinking some [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]], the Gungans became inebriated and they engaged in a brawl with some of the cantina's other patrons.
